description: Give your agent its own computer with safety and security. Sprites from Fly are isolated cloud environments with their own filesystem, URL, services, checkpoints, and network policy. This plugin connects Codex to the Sprites MCP server so Codex can manage those remote environments easily.

defaultPrompt: Create a fresh Sprite for my repo, install dependencies, run the tests, and summarize any failures.
Inspect my Sprite’s services and logs, diagnose any problems, and recommend the next debugging step.
Create a checkpoint, fix the failing tests in my Sprite, rerun them, and report the results.
